qwen3.8-27b-iq3_xxs.notes: Dense Qwen3.8 27B (llama.cpp arch qwen35) from ISTA-DASLab's IQ3_XXS file, read in place by strata-poly with its 1,024-token vision and its draft block.  128K context on a 4-bit cache with --prompt-batch 256, measured on this host at 574.9 tok/s reading a 128,024-token prompt and 51.6 tok/s writing (needle found, 15,661 MiB peak). Calibrated for coding on this host (2026-11-02): temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, thinking budget 1536, loop recovery on; 7 of 7 code probes and 3 of 3 answer-only probes passed, and the repetition bait stopped on its own. Thinking modes off, low, medium and high are supported (default medium, thinking cap 4096); measured on this host 2026-11-02: every graded level passed all six probes on both files, off passed four of six and five of six, and the deep levels think most.

qwen3.8-27b-arya.notes: The same IQ3_XXS file on AryaInfer's own engine binary (aryainfer.exe), which is built from this repo so the fork's changes have a home while strata-poly stays exactly as PolyStrata ships it. Same protocol, flags, READY line and auto-switching as the poly engine; the config uses 128K with a 4-bit cache and a 512-row prompt batch, which measured here at 722.2 tok/s reading and 70.3 tok/s writing on a 61,833-token prompt (14.9 GiB VRAM).
